definitions.explanation: Something that occurs only once or is not part of a series. Used for events, jobs, broadcasts, and other activities that are not recurring.
In technical contexts, having only one engine (aircraft) or firing one shot at a time (firearms).

examples.japanese: {単発|たんぱつ}のアルバイトを{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a one-time part-time job.

examples.japanese: このドラマは{連続|れんぞく}ではなく{単発|たんぱつ}だ。
examples.english: This drama is a standalone, not a series.

examples.japanese: {単発|たんぱつ}のイベントだったが、{好評|こうひょう}で{定期開催|ていきかいさい}になった。
examples.english: It was a one-time event, but it was well received and became a regular event.

examples.japanese: {単発|たんぱつ}エンジンの{小型機|こがたき}が{着陸|ちゃくりく}した。
この{銃|じゅう}は{単発|たんぱつ}で、{一発|いっぱつ}ずつ{装填|そうてん}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: This gun is single-shot and needs to be loaded one round at a time.

examples.japanese: {単発|たんぱつ}の{飛行機|ひこうき}は{双発機|そうはつき}より{燃費|ねんぴ}がいい。
examples.english: Single-engine planes have better fuel efficiency than twin-engine ones.

notes:
Composed of {単|たん} (single) and {発|ぱつ} (emission, shot). Sense 1 is far more common in everyday use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {単発|たんぱつ}の{仕事|しごと}: one-time job
- {単発|たんぱつ}ドラマ: standalone TV drama (not a series)
- {単発|たんぱつ}のイベント: one-off event
- {単発|たんぱつ}{講座|こうざ}: single-session course

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {連続|れんぞく}: serial, continuous — the opposite of one-time
- {連載|れんさい}: serialized — for publications
- {一回限|いっかいかぎ}り: one time only — emphasizes the limit
- {一度|いちど}きり: only once — more emotional/emphatic
